CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PRESSURE.title: Pressure
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PRESSURE.descrip: Each stack of [gold]Pressure[/gold] increases damage taken by 1%.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORY.title: Memory
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORY.descripti:
Increases cost by 1 each time played.
At the end of your turn, if in hand, [red]Forget[/red] it.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.title: Knight's Sword
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.descriptio: For each stack of [gold]Pressure[/gold] you gain, [gold]Knight's Sword[/gold] deals 1 additional damage.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORYSAKI.title: Sakiko's Memories
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORYSAKI.descr:
You can view Memory cards in the [blue]Memory Pile[/blue].
The [blue]Memory Pile[/blue] cannot record cards in the [red]Forgotten Pile[/red].
[b][blue]Often brings me pain, yet constantly inspires me to move forward.[/blue][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SAKIFORGET.title: Forget
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SAKIFORGET.descr:
Cards that are [red]Forgotten[/red] enter the [red]Forgotten Pile[/red].
Each time you [red]Forget[/red] a card, reduce [gold]Pressure[/gold] by 2.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_EGGS.title: Easter Egg
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_EGGS.description: Easter egg cards that are not balanced and are largely unrelated to the mod.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NOCHEST.title: Twelve Pill Steel Plate Cost Reduction
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NOCHEST.descript: The cost reduction formula is 12/(2×number of allies). Upgraded: 12/(number of allies).
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYPIANO.title: Piano Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYPIANO.descri: A special Attack belonging to Sakiko.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_OTHER_ANON.title: Alternate World Anon
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_OTHER_ANON.descr: [sine][pink]It doesn't seem like something I know, yet it feels familiar.[/pink][/sine]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_REMEMBER_CHORD.d:
Right-click the relic to view [pink]Chord learning progress[/pink].
Entering a Rest Site will learn a new [gold]Chord[/gold].
Note types: Attack [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_attack.png[/img], Skill [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_skill.png[/img], Power [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_power.png[/img], Special [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_special.png[/img].
[b][pink]Uwaa... I haven't practiced for so long, I almost forgot.[/pink][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYGUITAR.title: Guitar Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYGUITAR.descr: A special Attack belonging to Anon.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.title: Chord
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.descriptio:
The first time you play it, gain a temporary extra [gold]Chord[/gold] slot.
Playing it again will store a corresponding [gold]Chord[/gold].
Equipped to your [pink]guitar[/pink], these [pink]Chords[/pink] can be formed by [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_note.png[/img] during combat.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_LEARNED_CHORDS.d: All [pink]Chords[/pink] learned during this run. You can equip them as [pink]Memorized Chords[/pink] at Rest Sites.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NO_NOTE.title: Special Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NO_NOTE.descript: Playing this card does not grant [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_note.png[/img].

CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_ANON_NOTE.descri: Can match any type of [img]CuteSakikoMod/images/ui/text/text_note.png[/img] to form a [pink]Chord[/pink].

CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PANCAKE.title: Pancake Strike
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PANCAKE.descript: Deals 9 damage to an enemy. This damage can be blocked by Block. If Block exceeds the damage, HP is unaffected and only Block is reduced. If Block is less than the damage, HP is reduced by the difference, then this card goes to the discard pile. If upgraded: Deals 10 damage to a targeted enemy. If you have no draw-preventing debuffs, draw 2 cards from your draw pile, then this card goes to the discard pile. If you have a draw-preventing debuff, only the 10 damage is dealt, then this card goes to the discard pile.
